text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(――The basic rule of investigation is the 
stakeout. 
From this spot, I have a clear view of the 
archives room entrance.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(A few days ago, the Disciplinary 
Committee gave me a special mission. 
Namely――an investigation into the reality 
of what's happening in the archives room.)

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lately, some students have been sneaking 
into the archives room. Multiple students, 
in fact. 
Even though it's kept locked because of 
all the valuable historical documents 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is that not trespassing?! It will be too 
late once materials are damaged. 
Preventing incidents before they occur is 
our duty!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Who, by what method, and for what purpose 
are they sneaking into the archives―― 
I will uncover the truth. To protect the 
peace and order of Tracen Academy!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(If any student acts suspiciously in front 
of the archives, I will question them 
immediately! 
Come at me, intruders!)
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(How strange... Forget intruders, not a 
single soul has walked past here...?!)

text_block_list.name: Passing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's Fenomeno. She's glaring so 
intensely... 
If I walk in front of her, she'll 
definitely scold me for my uniform... 
Guess I'll take the stairs on the other 
side.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Could it be that the reason no students 
are coming... 
is because of me?!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Ah, Fenomeno-chan! Haaai, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, so that's why you were on lookout. 
The archives room... 
That's the room that's always locked, 
right! Next to the library――

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Wait... the library? Come to think of it, 
I don't know if it's related, but... 
I saw Boo-chan acting weird in the library 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You mean Narita Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Boo-chan came out from the very back 
of the library, which is rare for her. 
I asked her what she was doing, but she 
just said, "None of your business."

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
But I was super curious! 
So I chased after her asking her to tell 
me, and Boo-chan finally gave in.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
She said, "You really never give up, do 
you?" 
and finally told me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san actually answered you?! 
――So, what was she doing?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
She said, "I was planning to take a nap, 
but the remnants were too noisy."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Remnants...? How cryptic. Brian-san's 
comment is intriguing, but... 
First, let's gather intel on what's in the 
back of the library!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――Excuse me, you're a library committee 
member, correct? May I question you for a 
moment? 
The Disciplinary Committee received a tip 
from a certain source――

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?! I-I'm s-s-so sorry, I wasn't 
slacking off! 
I was just checking manga! I-I'll put it 
right back on the shelf! Excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry! I secretly returned a book 
that was way past its due date! 
I won't do it again... I'm so sorrrryyy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, I wasn't trying to reprimand you... 
W-Wait!! 
Urghhh... I can't even get a single word 
in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san, what's wrong? 
Are you in trouble? Did you want to talk 
to someone?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Library Committee member! What's 
at the very back of the library? 
I heard there's a place where you can take 
a nap!

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, take a nap? Who told you that? 
If a place like that existed, it'd be 
amazing. Unfortunately, there are only 
more books back there.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Aww, there isn't...? What a bummer. 
If there was a hidden room, it would be so 
fun, like a secret base.

text_block_list.name: Library Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
True. Ah, but... there is something like a 
hidden passage. 
It's not in use right now, but there's a 
door connecting to the archives room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there's a secret door?! 
I wonder what it's like~ I'm gonna go look 
for it! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-san...! Extracting new information 
through casual chitchat...! 
What splendid investigative questioning 
skills!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What a brilliant breakthrough!! 
There is a high probability that the door 
in the back of the library is how they've 
been sneaking into the archives!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean the place Boo-chan was 
trying to nap in was the archives room 
too? 
Maybe she decided not to go in because the 
remnants were too noisy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san is not an intruder. 
Which means the mystery we must pursue 
is――the door connecting the library and 
the archives room!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ――Is that true?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hm――Biko-san? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Earlier, Windy-senpai looked like she was 
up to no good, so I followed her. 
But I lost sight of her halfway through...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And that place was the back of the 
library! 
Maybe Windy-senpai used that secret door 
too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Is that true?! ――I will go borrow the key 
to the archives room! 
We might be able to catch the intruder 
red-handed!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm coming too! 
I wanna know what Windy-senpai is up to!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, if I rig this cloth above the 
entrance... 
It'll drop WHOOSH right onto the head of 
whoever walks underneath, nod!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, I found such a great hiding spot 
for my traps, nod! 
If I enter through the secret door from 
the library, no one will ever know I'm 
coming and going~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oho... So you didn't borrow the key, but 
entered via a secret passage. 
In other words――trespassing.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Caught red-handed! Apprehend the suspect!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“!!?!? Wha-wha... How did you find me 
out~~~!?”
